name: codeguru-security
description: On November 20, 2025, AWS will discontinue support for Amazon CodeGuru Security.

subcommands.name: batch-get-findings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of requested findings from standard scans.

subcommands.name: create-scan
subcommands.description: Use to create a scan using code uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: create-upload-url
subcommands.description: Generates a pre-signed URL, request headers used to upload a code resource, and code artifact identifier for the uploaded resource.

subcommands.name: get-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Use to get the encryption configuration for an account.

subcommands.name: get-findings
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all findings generated by a particular scan.

subcommands.name: get-metrics-summary
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of metrics for an account from a specified date, including number of open findings, the categories with most findings, the scans with most open findings, and scans with most open critical findings.

subcommands.name: get-scan
subcommands.description: Returns details about a scan, including whether or not a scan has completed.

subcommands.name: list-findings-metrics
subcommands.description: Returns metrics about all findings in an account within a specified time range.

subcommands.name: list-scans
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all scans in an account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all tags associated with a scan.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Use to add one or more tags to an existing scan.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Use to remove one or more tags from an existing scan.

subcommands.name: update-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Use to update the encryption configuration for an account.
